# Claude Platform release notes — captured 2026-08-14
# Source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/api
# (the two sources.json Anthropic URLs still 404 — see errors table)

### August 11, 2026  — NEW THIS SCAN, both reported 2026-08-14
- **Compliance API now returns transcripts of LOCAL sessions** — Cowork and Claude Code sessions
  that run on your users' machines. Beta, Claude Enterprise only. Three endpoints:
    GET /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local                      (list metadata, `clls_` IDs)
    GET /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local/{session_id}         (one session's metadata)
    GET /v1/compliance/apps/sessions/local/{session_id}/messages (transcript)
  Same Compliance Access Key + `read:compliance_user_data` scope as the existing chat/file/project
  endpoints — no new key, scope, setting or client update. Admin API keys are REJECTED (403).
  `product_surface`: `cowork` (Claude Desktop) | `claude_code` (terminal, Desktop, IDE extension).
  Transcript = user prompts, assistant text, `tool_use` and `tool_result` blocks; MCP tool calls and
  most server tool calls are NORMALIZED into the same tool_use/tool_result shapes. CLAUDE.md project
  instruction files appear as ordinary user content; skill content appears when the client sends it.
  NOT returned: thinking blocks; the system prompt (a `[system prompt content not shown]` synthetic
  marker stands in); tool DEFINITIONS and MCP server CONFIGURATION; images/PDFs/binary blocks.
  Documented capture blind spots: Claude Code authenticated with a Console API key or run through
  **Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud or Microsoft Foundry**; Claude Code on the web; organizations with
  **HIPAA readiness**; sessions under **ZDR**; and under **CMEK** sessions list but content is
  withheld. Retention 6 years by default or the org's custom conversation retention period.
  Read-only — no deletion through the API. `provenance` field marks content_unavailable /
  client_asserted / synthetic_marker. Byte caps `tool_use_input_max_bytes` and
  `tool_result_max_bytes` default 10,000, `-1` = server max (~1 MiB).
  /docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-sessions#retrieve-local-sessions
- **`anthropic-workspace-id` response header** added to the Claude API. Carries the `wrkspc_`-prefixed
  ID of the workspace that the request's API key or access token resolved to, including the
  organization's Default Workspace.  /docs/en/manage-claude/workspaces

### August 10, 2026
- Claude Sonnet 5 introductory pricing ($2/$10 per MTok) becomes the standard price; the scheduled
  Sept 1 increase will not occur.  [PRICING — not reported]

### August 7, 2026  (reported 2026-08-09)
- Managed Agents session budgets (`budget_reached` stop reason); session advisor
  (`{"type":"advisor"}` in the multiagent roster); `inference_geo` pinning; skills auto-discovered
  from a mounted GitHub repository's root `.claude/skills` directory.

### August 5, 2026  (reported 2026-08-07)
- Inference hooks beta for Claude Enterprise.  Claude Opus 4.1 retired.

### August 3, 2026  (reported 2026-08-09 via remote-session endpoints)
- Compliance API returns transcripts of REMOTE Cowork sessions (claude.ai web/mobile), `cse_` IDs,
  `product_surface` = `cowork_remote`. Note for cross-reference: remote sessions can be
  **agent-owned** — `user` null, `agent_id` (`cagt_` prefix) set, `started_by_user` names the human
  who initiated the run (e.g. a scheduled task).

### August 1, 2026
- Dreams (research preview) supports Claude Opus 5.  [below bar — model support add]

### July 2026 and earlier
Unchanged: Opus 5 (Jul 24), mid-conversation tool changes, `fallbacks` "default" mode, Opus 4.7
fast-mode removal, Managed Agents `effort` + environment/memory-store webhooks + `initial_events` +
thread event deltas (Jul 22), Workbench sunset (Jul 17), mid-conversation system messages (Jul 15),
Claude Enterprise Admin API user management (Jul 14), Dreams model adds + Access Transparency
`cmek_preserve` detail (Jul 10), API key expiration (Jul 8).

Standing coverage note: keep watching /docs/en/managed-agents/* — fast-moving and under-covered here.

Updated: 2026-08-14 — TWO new dated entries (Aug 11). The local-session Compliance endpoints are the
most significant Anthropic addition since the Aug 5 inference hooks.
